title: PKCS#11 Semantics and Public-Key API Extension
summary: The modular cryptographic-API model covers symmetric keys; formalizing further PKCS#11 attribute semantics and extending the model to public-key functionality remain open.

formal_statement.body: Extend the existing modular cryptographic-API model beyond its symmetric-key scope by identifying and formalizing the intended semantics of PKCS#11 attributes not yet treated and extending the model to support public-key functionality.

scope.domain: Modular security modeling of cryptographic APIs, including PKCS#11 attributes and public-key functionality.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Identify and formalize the intended semantics of untreated PKCS#11 attributes and extend the model to public-key functionality.

citations.label: A Modular Treatment of Cryptographic APIs: The Symmetric-Key Case

progress.summary: The source presents its symmetric-key model as a suitable starting point for further extension and explicitly leaves PKCS#11 attribute semantics and public-key functionality as open tasks.
citation_labels: Thomas Shrimpton et al., A Modular Treatment of Cryptographic APIs: The Symmetric-Key Case
